card.fires_on: Small connecting or structural tokens in scraped web page furniture, such as the closing parenthesis after a news source, the space inside a date, or the word in a navigation link or caption. It fires inconsistently across these.

modes.label: Dates and file listings
modes.description: The space or gap inside a written date, such as between day-month and year.

modes.label: Navigation and caption words
modes.description: A word inside a navigation link, caption or revision stamp.

modes.label: Source tag brackets
modes.description: The closing bracket of a news source tag at the start of an article.
